title: iPhone free for 10 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 10 min (since 03:33Z; released by fix-scrollcb-g0 (process hold ended)). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: cm-return (owner fix-cm-return; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-cm-return takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
